note: Produced-artifact dependency baseline (no-new-rot ratchet, cinatra#2537). `undeclaredProducesDeps` = a `cinatra.produces`/`consumes` entry whose target extension is NOT declared in the SAME manifest's `cinatra.dependencies` as a required artifact-kind edge — installing the producer therefore never installs the produced artifact and every run fails materialization. `unresolvedProducesTargets` = a produced target that does not resolve to a real artifact extension in the synced catalog (absent / wrong kind / unclaimed objectTypeId) — so declaring it as a dependency would not fix anything. `notes` carries the REASON each grandfathered (package, target) pair is tolerated — a manual, version-controlled record; NOT diffed by the gate. These are CURRENT tolerated misses; the gate fails on NEW/GROWN entries. Regenerate the data with `node scripts/audit/extension-produces-deps-gate.mjs --write-baseline` — every data entry should only ever be REMOVED (fix the producing repo, then bump its pin), never added; carry `notes` forward by hand for anything re-baselined this way.
